detailed_descriptions.en: Explore a charming countryside as a young bike courier named Neha. In this short but satisfying adventure, playable entirely with your mouse , you'll deliver milk bottles , gather food for your pet cow Milki, meet friendly and intriguing characters, and help the community by completing a variety of small quests. Deliver Milk 🐮 You and Milki are starting a dairy delivery service! Earn money, collect resources, upgrade your barn, and slowly grow your business. Explore the countryside 🌻 Lush meadows, green forests, a glittering ocean: this land has so much beauty to discover! To find every little secret and meet everyone, you'll need to upgrade your bike and choose your path wisely. Reconnect the Community 💌 Once known as "the land of cows", this region has slowly been deserted after a mysterious event that affected all of the cattle. Delivery after delivery, the residents will tell you more about their past as you build a future together! Features ✅ What Milki Delivery offers: A short adventure: 3-5h of beautiful landscapes, light resource management, gentle decisions, and short dialogues. A fully mouse-driven experience: Click to control Neha throughout her journey and to interact with the world. Simple game mechanics : Choose your path, sell milk, gather ingredients, and complete little quests. A cozy mood : Summer vibes, hand-drawn side-scrolling landscapes, cute characters, and lovely music! Everything is kept simple with no possibility of failure : play at your own pace! ❌ What Milki Delivery does NOT offer: No big odyssey with hours-long quests or a branching narrative. No arcade cycling gameplay with direct bicycle controls. No multiplayer of any kind. Dev team Hey, this is Blibloop and Doot talking! After making Minami Lane together, we wanted to explore something entirely different with a game less centered on management and more on discovery of both a world and its people. For this game, we’re collaborating once again with Zakku, our composer, whose music and sounds continue to shape the heart of our games. This is new to us and we still consider ourselves beginners, so please be kind with your expectations, and know that we will do our best! We really hope you'll enjoy our little game, Milki Delivery 💖

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Explore a charming countryside as a young bike courier named Neha. In this short but satisfying adventure, playable entirely with your mouse, you'll deliver milk bottles, gather food for your pet cow Milki, meet friendly and intriguing characters, and help the community by completing a variety of small quests.

Deliver Milk 🐮

You and Milki are starting a dairy delivery service! Earn money, collect resources, upgrade your barn, and slowly grow your business.

Explore the countryside 🌻

Lush meadows, green forests, a glittering ocean: this land has so much beauty to discover! To find every little secret and meet everyone, you'll need to upgrade your bike and choose your path wisely.

Reconnect the Community 💌

Once known as "the land of cows", this region has slowly been deserted after a mysterious event that affected all of the cattle. Delivery after delivery, the residents will tell you more about their past as you build a future together!

Features

✅ What Milki Delivery offers:

  • A short adventure: 3-5h of beautiful landscapes, light resource management, gentle decisions, and short dialogues.

  • A fully mouse-driven experience: Click to control Neha throughout her journey and to interact with the world.

  • Simple game mechanics: Choose your path, sell milk, gather ingredients, and complete little quests.

  • A cozy mood: Summer vibes, hand-drawn side-scrolling landscapes, cute characters, and lovely music!

  • Everything is kept simple with no possibility of failure: play at your own pace!

❌ What Milki Delivery does NOT offer:

  • No big odyssey with hours-long quests or a branching narrative.

  • No arcade cycling gameplay with direct bicycle controls.

  • No multiplayer of any kind.

Dev team

Hey, this is Blibloop and Doot talking! After making Minami Lane together, we wanted to explore something entirely different with a game less centered on management and more on discovery of both a world and its people.

For this game, we’re collaborating once again with Zakku, our composer, whose music and sounds continue to shape the heart of our games.

This is new to us and we still consider ourselves beginners, so please be kind with your expectations, and know that we will do our best! We really hope you'll enjoy our little game, Milki Delivery 💖
